name: B10-0175/2024 (The Left) – Recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text:
The European Parliament welcomes a new European Union plan to protect people from second-hand smoke and from aerosols like those from e-cigarettes. It asks member states to ban smoking and vaping in more public places, especially outdoors where children, young people and pregnant women go, such as playgrounds, pools and schools. It also calls for more research on the health risks, action against illegal vapes, help for people to quit smoking, and tighter rules on tobacco advertising, taxes and lobbying.

- The plan is a recommendation, so national governments decide whether to apply it.
- It affects smokers, vapers, bystanders, children and tobacco companies.
- Next, member states decide on bans, and the Commission must report back in four years.
